highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 will add rendering, platform, performance, and data-safety improvements.
highlights_body: The next release targets Uno Platform 7, modern native toolchains, Android display synchronization, and more efficient managed image and text processing.

bullets.lead: Uno, Apple, Windows, and WebGPU support updated
bullets.detail: Adds Uno Platform 7 support, raises Apple deployment minimums, aligns Windows native dependencies with current MAUI releases, and packages WebGPU support in the static native library.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: CString conversion no longer reads past native buffers
bullets.detail: Creates SKData directly from the native string data without a buffer over-read.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention to release data when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing reduce managed overhead
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed pixel copies, pools HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers, and avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocation during decoding.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Uno Platform 7 support and packaged WebGPU support in the static native library
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and stabilized Blazor sample test startup
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual policy findings in continuous integration
contributor_summaries.Saad-elnagar: Removed an obsolete libmicrohttpd attribution notice
